contentItem.title: 圆内接多边形
contentItem.englishTitle: A rectilineal figure is said to be inscribed in a circle when each angle of the inscribed figure lies on the circumference of the circle.

surfaces.text: A rectilineal figure is said to be inscribed in a circle when each angle of the inscribed figure lies on the circumference of the circle.
据说,当所标的图的每个角度位于圆周圆的周界时,将直线图刻在一个圆形中。（相关点与线段：A）
